references.text: The hand of the witnesses shall be the first to strike down the guilty, a principle repeated here regarding the responsibility of witnesses in execution.
A command to purge evil from among Israel; the same wording is used to emphasize the need to remove sin from the people.
The same expression 'purge the evil from your midst' is used concerning the removal of a rebellious son.
The stoning of one who has committed sexual immorality, with the same formula about purging evil from Israel.
The same command to purge evil in connection with adultery.
Purging evil from Israel in cases of kidnapping, using the same wording.
The witnesses lay their hands on the one who blasphemed, and the whole community stones him.
Jesus refers to the principle that the sinless one should cast the first stone, alluding to the role of the witnesses.
At Stephen's stoning, the witnesses laid their clothes at Saul's feet, in line with the requirement that witnesses cast the first stones.
Paul directly quotes 'Drive out the evil from among you' and applies the principle of cleansing the community from sin.
